name: progress
title: Progress
description: Native progress element with a gooey value bar and semantic tone variants.

.caps-gooey-progress:not(:indeterminate).backgroundImage:
radial-gradient(
        ellipse 12px 5px at calc(100% - 5px) 40%,
        rgb(255 255 255 / var(--caps-progress-tip-light)),
        transparent
      ),
      linear-gradient(
        to bottom,
        rgb(0 0 0 / calc(var(--depth) * 0.12)),
        rgb(255 255 255 / calc(var(--depth) * 0.08)) 45%,
        transparent 65%,
        rgb(0 0 0 / calc(var(--depth) * 0.18))
      )
.caps-gooey-progress:not(:indeterminate).boxShadow:
inset 0 1px 1px rgb(0 0 0 / calc(var(--depth) * 0.12)),
      inset 0 -1px 1px rgb(0 0 0 / calc(var(--depth) * 0.16))
